citations.text: Open Supply Hub. Open Supply Hub facility data.

description: Open Supply Hub's open register of production facilities in global supply chains, with each facility's name, address, coordinates, sector and contributors: real facility geography for location models. tasks/v1 is the target, each facility a node with its position. The terms of service grant the facility information under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence.

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (Open Supply Hub terms of service, section 2.2)

name: Open Supply Hub facilities

recipe.reason: The bulk download and the API need a user account and its API token (an unauthenticated API request answers 401). keepset models such a source as brokered, but the one brokered fetch it has is the Mozilla Data Collective's adapter, and there is no adapter that authenticates to Open Supply Hub. Tracked in https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/313.
